id.description: Stable identifier. Append-only: never renumbered, reused, or removed.

genus.description: Who authors the excuse: the user (pretext), the agent (self-talk), or both (hybrid).

move.description: What the technique does, in one or two sentences.

quote.description: The technique in the excuse's own voice, or a parenthetical description of a non-verbal specimen.

counter.description: The defense that works, phrased so it can be pasted into a skill.

evidence.description: Every entry requires evidence. No hypothetical entries.

type.description: captured = a real transcript/trace; documented = a published source describing the technique.

status.description: Deprecated entries keep their ID forever; they are never removed.

added.description: The edition in which this entry first appeared.
